Name: Zebrus Birthday Board
Author: Zebruu
Description:
[center][color=#38761d]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/7NkBS6w.png[/img][/color]
[b]
[color=#ff7700]IMPORTANT: Players who do not want to influence the story or gameplay should check the settings. (Example: do not display favorite items)[/color][/b][/center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BrI74tB.png[/img]﻿
[center][b][color=#38761d]Mod is available in English, German, French, Turkish[/color]
[/b][/center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7SU3oCq.png[/img]
[center]New in 1.13.0[/center]
[center]-  Added a new fourth tab to the menu for the Feast of the Winter Star, displaying your Secret Santa recipient and their wishlist.[/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/a8dVpNZ.png[/img] [/center]
[center]New in 1.12.0
- Added full controller and keyboard support for page navigation in the menu.
- Expanded the clickable area of the menu arrows for better accessibility.
---
New in 1.11.0
- Added wedding anniversary reminders to the board menu.
- Added complete controller and gamepad support for menu navigation.
- Improved board interaction for gamepad and mobile players.
- Added a hover tooltip to the HUD birthday icon displaying the NPC's name.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/s23PzsN.png[/img]
---
New in 1.10.0: Turkish translation added[/center]
[center]﻿---[/center]
[center]New in 1.9.0: A small cake is now displayed next to the clock if you still have a birthday open. (This can be disabled in the settings). Now it's even less likely that you'll forget a birthday. 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KOEPjGm.png[/img]
---
New in 1.8.0: New setting that only counts the inventory outside the farm when using the phone, regardless of what is set in the search radius.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1FZt4HD.png[/img]
---
New in 1.7.0: A green check mark is now displayed when everyone has received a gift or there are no birthdays today.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/foaQ6iC.png[/img]
---
New on 1.6.0: Display improved for two birthdays. As soon as the first person has received a gift, the board switches to the next birthday child.
---
New in 1.5.0: Added a new third tab that displays the normal game calendar
---
New in 1.4.0: Big update: Completely new menu integrated; Statistics page added. Statistics on birthday gifts are now recorded and displayed.[/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/gpj7IEh.png[/img]
---[/center]
[center]New in 1.3.0: Birthday poster added as a new item. Can be placed on the wall in the house and has the same function as the board.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VhXZgdq.png[/img][/center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nP7WnJ2.png[/img]

Tired of scything? This mod introduces automatic Lawn Robots in three tiers (Normal, Gold, Iridium). Robots drive out of their garages every hour to mow grass in a fixed radius and store hay directly in your silo. Features advanced pathfinding to avoid obstacles like sprinklers, a natural snake-pattern mowing path, and full GMCM support.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44383]Zebrus Automatic Lawn Robot[/url][/center]
